name: angelic_destiny_enchanted_creature_is_an_angel
notes: M4 mapper. Printed: 'Enchanted creature gets +4/+4, has flying and first strike, and is an Angel in addition to its other types.' Support card: FDN Lyra Dawnbringer ('Other Angels you control get +1/+1 and have lifelink.'; an M7 record, unverified when this pack was written). Seat 0's 2/2 Bear is enchanted: +4/+4 from the Aura and, being an Angel now, +1/+1 from Lyra: 7/7. The Bear attacks unblocked: it deals 7 (seat 1 to 13) and, with Lyra's lifelink, seat 0 gains 7.
